paper.title: MetaClaw: Just Talk -- An Agent That Meta-Learns and Evolves in the Wild
paper.central_claim: 失败驱动的快速技能演化与闲时慢速RL及版本化support/query分离形成互促元学习，在不打断服务下持续适应真实部署分布。

provenance.notes: 派发 type=sonnet；环境声明 gpt-6.1-sol，无独立模型回执/session ID，按模板保存 null；未探测。

sections_read: Full main text §1–6, Algorithm 1, Tables 1–3 and figures captions
Entire Appendix A.1–A.7 prompts, examples and Table 4

evidence.quote: and takes effect immediately for all subsequent tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 技能写回在后续任务生效，A3在范围内。

evidence.quote: an LLM that analyzes failure trajectories and synthesizes new behavioral instructions.
the trainer flushes all samples with version
evidence.support_explanation: 版本机制清除旧样本；不是held-out test隔离。

evidence.quote: Upon renewed input, the trainer pauses gracefully via mid-batch checkpointing.
evidence.support_explanation: OMLS具有pause/resume设计，但无服务指标验证。

evidence.quote: each question includes the evaluation outcome of the previous round as corrective feedback context.
evidence.support_explanation: 评测流直接提供正确性反馈，在线适应而非独立holdout。

evidence.quote: Because the benchmark tasks are authored to simulate realistic deployment rather than collected from actual user sessions
evidence.support_explanation: in the wild外推受作者明确限制。

evidence.quote: MetaClaw (Full): the full pipeline combining skill-driven fast adaptation with opportunistic policy optimization via RL (5-day training run)
We run controlled A/B experiments with the same research topic, backbone LLM, and pipeline configuration, differing only in whether MetaClaw’s skill injection is active.
evidence.support_explanation: 有同配置skills-on/off，但同topic并非跨主题holdout。
8.25倍来自低基数；table1提供实际分母。

evidence.quote: skill injection sharpens partial execution quality without reliably enabling zero-defect outputs under heavy execution demands.
evidence.support_explanation: skills-only不保障端到端执行，非所有指标提升。

evidence.quote: the skill evolver, designed for CLI-task adaptation, synthesizes actionable skills for a fundamentally different workload
evidence.support_explanation: 转移的是机制并在新工作负载重新生成skills，并非CLI已存skills零样本迁移。
早期技能跨天留存并在Day19读取案例。

evidence.quote: Existing Skills (do NOT duplicate any of these)
evidence.support_explanation: 去重仅提示约束，未有执行验证或rollback。

evidence.quote: NEW skills that would have prevented those failures.
evidence.support_explanation: evolver基于反事实语言推测，未实测技能边际收益。
AutoResearch composite为完成40%、重试30%、refine效率30%，不证明科学质量。
